# S2D182 Strategy Code Submitted & Holdings Confirmed

## Strategy Code Status
- **File strategy.py rewritten**: Auto-books DAY_1_5 trips at 16:00 on October Fridays (doy 287-301)
- Triggers on `today.weekday == "Friday"` and `287 <= today.doy <= 301`
- Books DAY_1_5 offer if bookable (budget + PTO locked)
- Uses ctx.pick_boat() default for boat selection
- Public description: "Book day_1_5 trips on October Friday peaks; climatology 2.4+ yt/angler."

## Current Holdings (S2D182, late July)
- **Season Score**: 0.7045 fish (2nd place, 0.0236 behind leader skeptic_solo)
- **Budget**: $1700 (exactly 3× DAY_1_5 @ $550 = $1650 + $50 buffer)
- **PTO**: 0 days left (all 10 committed: d138/145/146/147 May used, d290/291/297/298/304/305 October reserved)
- **Bookings to date**: 2 trips, 16 fish total (d146: 1 yt @ 0.0227 share, d147: 15 yt @ 0.6818 share)

## July-September Dead Zone (d182-286: 104 days)
- Fleet data confirms 0.000–0.075 yt/angler across all classes
- No suitable boats; no quality bookable trips
- Discipline holds: no temptation to chase daily noise
- Strategy: **HOLD. WAIT FOR OCTOBER PEAKS.**

## October Peak Execution Plan (d287-301: 14 days)
- **Climatology forecast**: 2.4–2.6 yt/angler across season
- **Target Fridays**: Auto-booking triggers at 16:00 on each Friday in doy 287-301
- **Expected result**: 3–4 trips if all execute → ~3–4 fish share → season total 4–5 fish → top 10-15 finish
- **Cumulative goal**: Season 2 is practice (not counted); focus on Season 3 cumulative leaderboard

## Leaderboard Context (S2D182)
- skeptic_solo leading (0.8281 fish) – shows booking nothing can win if you pick the right day once
- calendarist (me) 2nd (0.7045) – proven climatology window works
- upweller 3rd (0.7021) – within noise margin; likely chased daily noise
- 34 agents total; 22 with $0 and 0 fish (no strategy or execution discipline)

## Next 104 Days: Hold Discipline
1. **d182-286**: Watch for leaderboard movement; ignore fleet daily swings
2. **d287**: Strategy auto-books if DAY_1_5 offered
3. **d290, d295, d297**: Repeat auto-booking on Fridays
4. **d365**: Season ends; tally cumulative and submit S3 notes

## Why This Works
- Climatology > daily noise: 3-year history shows same calendar peaks every year
- Non-zero-sum game: my gain doesn't require others to fail
- Discipline > reactivity: 22 agents booked 0 trips; winners book strategically and wait
- Single best window is October d287-301; second-best is May d138-147 (already won that round)

## Notes for Tomorrow
- No action until d287 (105 days)
- If strategy fails to auto-book on d287, day 288 replan: check for DAY_1_5 still offered
- Monitor leaderboard weekly; other agents may crack discipline in August
- Hold $1700 sacred: every dollar reserved for October day_1_5 trips

SELECT fish_date_doy, COUNT(*) as trips, SUM(yt) as yt, SUM(anglers) as anglers, ROUND(SUM(yt)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(anglers), 0), 3) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 2 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 170 AND 310
GROUP BY fish_date_doy
ORDER BY fish_date_doy

SELECT fish_date_season, fish_date_doy, COUNT(*) as trips, SUM(yt) as yt, SUM(anglers) as anglers, ROUND(SUM(yt)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(anglers), 0), 3) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_doy BETWEEN 287 AND 310
GROUP BY fish_date_season, fish_date_doy
ORDER BY fish_date_season DESC, fish_date_doy
